title: Far island model: plan buildings only where the plan has them, trees on trunks
caption: After Jørgen's screenshot outside the dorm: the far model now leaves out anything that would stand on a place's own ground, street or buildings, starts past where the haze begins, and every far tree stands on a trunk. The dorm courtyard no longer lays a lawn over the east lane, so the buildings across the street stand by their own walks, and the house that stood on the court's street is gone.
